jobs.title: Badge A · Vermelho
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE small notification-badge background PNG sprite for the corner of a glossy fantasy postal mobile-game piggy-bank icon. The badge is a tiny separate OVERLAY, not a large backing medallion. Premium chunky simple casual mobile-game HUD style, rounded sculpted bevels, soft broad white specular highlights, deep colored edge shadow, crisp clean silhouette, very readable at 24 pixels. Center is FILLED and left visually quiet for live white text such as a number or exclamation mark; DO NOT paint any text or glyph into the image. No pig, no face, no coins, no currency, no ornaments or extra symbols. Centered on square canvas with 10 percent padding, transparent outside the shape, no checkerboard or background, no watermark. Shape: a simple plump round cherry-red enamel notification bubble, thin warm gold bevel outline, crimson lower edge and one soft crescent shine at upper left. Largest possible empty red center.
